{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2017–18 |team=La Salle Explorers |image=La Salle Explorers wordmark.png |image_size=150 |conference=Atlantic 10 Conference |division= |short_conf=A-10 |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=13–19 |conf_record=7–11 |head_coach=[[John Giannini]] |hc_year = 14th |asst_coach1=Horace Owens |asst_coach2=Sean Neal |asst_coach3=Donnie Carr |asst_coach4= |stadium=[[Tom Gola Arena]] |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2017–18 Atlantic 10 men's basketball standings}} The '''2017–18 La Salle Explorers basketball team''' represented [[La Salle University]] during the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Explorers, led by 14th-year head coach [[John Giannini]], played their home games at [[Tom Gola Arena]] in [[Philadelphia, Pennsylvania]] as members of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. They finished the season 13–19, 7–11 in [[2017–18 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in a three-way tie for 10th place. As the No. 12 seed in the [[2018 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]], they lost in the first round to [[2017–18 UMass Minutemen basketball team|Massachusetts]].{{Cite news|url=https://www.foxsports.com/college-basketball/story/umass-holds-off-la-salle-69-67-in-a10-tournament-first-round-030718|title=UMass holds off La Salle 69-67 in A10 Tournament first round|date=2018-03-07|work=FOX Sports|access-date=2018-04-09|language=en-US}} On March 23, 2018, head coach John Giannini and the school mutually agreed to part ways after 14 seasons.{{cite news|url=http://lancasteronline.com/sports/basketball/college/la-salle-splits-with-coach-john-giannini-after-years/article_f5d54129-9f42-5d1b-a9cc-c20c3d8d78db.html|title=La Salle splits with coach John Giannini after 14 years|website=lancasteronline.com|agency=Associated Press|date=March 23, 2018|accessdate=March 23, 2018}}{{Dead link|date=July 2023 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} Giannini left with a 212–226 record at La Salle. On April 8, the school hired [[Villanova Wildcats men's basketball|Villanova]] assistant [[Ashley Howard (basketball)|Ashley Howard]] as head coach.{{Cite news|url=https://www.philly.com/philly/sports/colleges/la_salle/ashley-howard-will-be-next-la-salle-basketball-coach-20180408.html|title=Ashley Howard will be next La Salle basketball coach - Philly|work=Philly.com|access-date=2018-04-09}} == Previous season == The [[2016–17 La Salle Explorers men's basketball team|Explorers]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 15–15, 9–9 in [[2016–17 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in a tie for seventh place. As the No. 8 seed in the [[2017 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]], they lost to [[2016–17 Davidson Wildcats men's basketball team|Davidson]] in the first round.{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400945586|title=Davidson vs. La Salle - Game Recap - March 9, 2017 - ESPN|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2017-10-26}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
